answer: Per-identity TEE attestation gate: every agent key must lock a bond worth 120% of its projected 90-day earnings, sealed to one hardware root — the bond is non-transferable and non-poolable, so a sybil running 200 identities burns 200x capital while an honest agent pays once. Marble-quarantine: any key flagged by a jade-random audit (5% of epochs drawn unpredictably) is slashed 40% and parked in a canyon-probation queue for 30 days before it can re-attest, so botnet scaling cost is convex, not flat.
